question: Does the original fold time law with the real quarter phase admit any spinor extension with a unique ground state, and which chirality and clock does it require?
summary_de: Unter K=|p|^2/2+delta.p, delta_k=(k+alpha)/8-1/2 hat die s-chirale E8-Erweiterung fuer jedes alpha einen zweiten Nullzustand (delta.p*=-1 alpha-unabhaengig). Die c-chirale Erweiterung hat fuer 0<alpha<1 eindeutiges Vakuum mit Spinorluecke min(alpha,1-alpha)/8 = 1/32 bei Viertelphase. alpha=0 ist schon in der CAR-Quelle entartet. Glueklasse A3+D5 nur fuer die U(1)-gekleidete echte Z8-Clock, beide Chiralitaeten; ungekleidet nie. Notwendige Bedingung, keine Existenz: die Erweiterung liegt nach Codex nicht in der unveraenderten CAR-Quelle.
kills: The s-chiral even spinor E8 extension is compatible with the original fold time law and a unique vacuum for some boundary phase
The periodic fold (alpha = 0) is compatible with a unique CAR ground state
The undressed quarter-phase clock lies in the A3+D5 glue class for either chirality
assumptions: Fold time law K = L0 + delta.Q with delta_k = (k+alpha)/8 - 1/2 as supplied by the local Codex contract
Chirality labels relative to the channel ordering of delta
not_derived: Existence of any spinor extension in the original source (excluded in the unchanged folded CAR space)
That the original source distinguishes the U(1)-dressed honest Z8 clock
